rationale: All 6 blocking findings from the final round (CR-001..CR-006) are resolved: current source confirms the sensitive-value hint now checks both path and value, the stripped-fields notice is cleared on edit/add and keyed off both visibility and content, hasCopyableValues delegates to collectCopyValuePaths so the dialog never opens empty, runClone's success path now surfaces the placeholder_value_present toast, a synchronous cloningRef guards against double-dispatch in handleCloneServer/handleConfirmClone/runClone, and cloneConfig no longer toggles the shared this.loading flag. No new findings raised; no evidence/decision findings were present to verify against fix_evidence.

standards_review.notes: All 5 commit subjects in range follow EPMCDME-15538: Capital sentence per git-workflow.md commit regex; no body violations observed
No .ai-run/guides/standards/code-quality.md exists in the repo and no artifact ref was passed for this check

findings.title: Sensitive hint misses args values
findings.problem: isSensitiveKey is tested only against the generated dotted-path string (e.g. 'args[0]'), never against the underlying value; args paths can never match the sensitive regex, so a secret passed via args (e.g. --api-key=xxx) never gets the 'May contain a sensitive value' hint that the same secret in headers/env would get.
findings.impact: A user cloning a server with a secret in args gets no warning before manually checking the box to copy it, silently defeating the hint's purpose of flagging likely secrets before they are propagated into the new config.
findings.recommendation: Evaluate isSensitiveKey against the original value as well as the path for every section, e.g. isSensitiveKey(key) || isSensitiveKey(String(originalValue)).

findings.title: Stale stripped-fields notice across modal reuse
findings.problem: strippedFields is cleared only in handleModalClose, never in handleEditServer/handleAddMCPServer; and MCPServerModal's showStrippedFieldsNotice dismissal resets only on props.visible changing, not on props.strippedFields changing.
findings.impact: A clone's stripped-fields banner can resurface with stale data on a later ordinary edit/add reached without an intervening modal close, or a dismissed banner can fail to reappear when a new clone response updates strippedFields while the same modal instance stays open; the exact UI sequence that reaches this was not independently confirmed, so this is capped below the critical rating the matching acceptance-criterion 'partial' status would otherwise warrant.
findings.recommendation: Clear strippedFields in handleEditServer and handleAddMCPServer, and add props.strippedFields to the notice-reset effect's dependency array so dismissal tracks both visibility and content.

findings.title: Copy-values dialog can open with nothing to copy
findings.problem: hasCopyableValues treats any truthy config.url as copyable, but collectCopyValuePaths only emits a 'url' section when the URL parses and has query params, and silently emits nothing on a parse failure. When url is the only truthy field and has no query string, or fails to parse, the two functions disagree.
findings.impact: The copy-values dialog opens with zero sections and no feedback - the user can only Cancel or confirm an empty clone, with no indication why nothing is offered.
findings.recommendation: Align hasCopyableValues with collectCopyValuePaths, e.g. derive hasUrl from the same URL-parsing/query-key logic, so the no-dialog path is taken whenever there is truly nothing to offer.

findings.title: Clone success never surfaces placeholder-value warning
findings.problem: runClone's success path only reads response.stripped_fields; unlike handleModalSubmit, it never checks response.warnings for a placeholder_value_present entry.
findings.impact: The explicit requirement that a placeholder_value_present warning toast appear after create/update/clone saves is unmet for the clone path - a cloned config that still carries a placeholder value gives the user no warning at all.
findings.recommendation: Apply the same response.warnings?.find(w => w.code === 'placeholder_value_present') -> toaster.info(...) check used in handleModalSubmit to the clone response inside runClone's success branch.

findings.title: Clone can be double-dispatched before disable renders
findings.problem: handleCloneServer dispatches runClone(server, undefined) immediately on click with no check against an already-in-flight cloningId; the Clone menu item is disabled only once cloningId's state update re-renders.
findings.impact: A rapid double-click/double-select on Clone before the disabled state renders can fire two concurrent clone requests for the same server, creating duplicate cloned configs.
findings.recommendation: Guard handleCloneServer (and handleConfirmClone) with an early return when cloningId is already set for that server, in addition to the UI-level disabled state.

findings.title: Clone reuses whole-table loading flag
findings.problem: cloneConfig sets the same shared this.loading flag used by indexConfigs' full-list fetch; MCPManagementPage passes that same loading into the Table's whole-page loading state, even though a dedicated cloningId already exists specifically to scope in-flight state to the one row being cloned.
findings.impact: Triggering a single-row clone can toggle the whole table into its loading/disabled state, disrupting other in-progress interactions on the page for an operation meant to be scoped to one row.
findings.recommendation: Scope clone's in-flight indicator to cloningId only; don't set the shared this.loading flag from cloneConfig, or give cloneConfig its own loading flag that the Table doesn't consume.

finding_status.notes: collectValueByPath + isSensitivePath now evaluate the sensitive regex against the underlying value for every section, including args
handleEditServer/handleAddMCPServer now clear strippedFields; notice-reset effect depends on [props.visible, props.strippedFields]
hasCopyableValues now delegates to collectCopyValuePaths(server).length > 0, guaranteeing agreement with the dialog's own section logic
runClone's success branch now checks response.warnings for placeholder_value_present and calls toaster.info, matching handleModalSubmit
cloningRef synchronous guard added in handleCloneServer, handleConfirmClone and runClone, closing the pre-render double-dispatch window
cloneConfig no longer sets this.loading; comment documents the deliberate scoping to the caller's cloningId
